title: Glioblastoma transcriptomic-signature measurement manuscript reproducibility
description: Minimal reproducibility code for Transcriptomic signatures preserve biological direction without uniquely specifying state in glioblastoma. Eight certified principal modules and 78 current Results claims; explicit aggregate-validation, public-processed-input and source-dependent tiers. No raw or observation-level study data. This independent manuscript repository is separate from the older canonical-MES project and the MeasureQual v0.10.0 software.
